name: ca.sitesy/website-intelligence
title: Sitesy Website Intelligence
description: Website, DNS and Canada weather tools, 12 in all. Callers pay per call in USDC on Base via x402.

tools.name: website_intelligence
tools.description: Full website report for one domain: published contact details, tech stack clues, transport security, response headers, DNS records, certificate basics, and hygiene findings ranked by severity. Use this for a one shot overview; use the smaller tools when you need only one of those parts. Costs 0.01 USDC per call. The caller pays per call in USDC on Base through x402: the first call returns the payment requirements, and an x402 aware MCP client signs and retries automatically.

domain.description: A domain name, for example example.com
